_doc: Canonical shape of project_context.sr_recent_miss_examples. Producer: backend/app/routers/agent.py (response['project_context']['sr_recent_miss_examples']). Consumer: agent/src/prompts/project-context.ts -> formatSrRecentMissExamplesForSrPrompt. Contract tests on both sides load this file; if the shape diverges, both tests must be updated. A byte-identical copy is kept at backend/testing/__fixtures__/sr_recent_miss_examples_contract.json so the backend Docker test (which has no access to agent/) can read it; test_claim_sr_recent_miss_examples_fixture_parity asserts the two files match when both are reachable.
